home.title: Dog Services in Arnhem North
home.intro: Find the service you are looking for and sign up for an introduction, no strings attached. Your dog is my client, and together we will make it a great experience.

uitlaatservice.heading: Dog Walking
uitlaatservice.subheading: Burn off energy and socialise with other dogs.
uitlaatservice.body: Have your dog picked up once or several times a week. Dogs walk for at least an hour and never spend more than an hour in the van. Each group has six fixed slots, plus two kept free for dogs staying in boarding or for clients whose schedule does not fit the regular rounds. Groups are put together with care — there is a puppy group on Fridays and even a full doodle group. To keep travel time short, my service area is limited to Arnhem North, Schaarsbergen and the surrounding area.

opvang.heading: Boarding
opvang.subheading: For a day, a week, or a full holiday.
opvang.body: Everyone gets away now and then, and however nice it is to take your dog along, sometimes you want something different. Since January 2025, Walkedo clients can use the boarding service. Let your dog run and play in a 25 square metre kennel while you and your family enjoy your holiday. Boarding dogs automatically join the walking groups.

northernInuit.heading: Northern Inuit Dog
northernInuit.subheading: A rare breed known from Game of Thrones, now in the Netherlands.
northernInuit.body: The Walkedo kennel is the first in the Netherlands to keep this rare breed. Get to know it. We expect a litter of pups in the coming years — join the waiting list without obligation. Once plans firm up, you will be first in line to reserve a place and become the owner of a best friend from this beautiful breed.

casting.heading: Casting
casting.subheading: A wolf lookalike for photo or video
casting.body: Northern Inuit dogs look strikingly like wolves, are very patient, and pick up instructions quickly. That makes them an ideal match for film and photo productions, large and small.

uitlaatservice.title: Dog walking service
uitlaatservice.intro: From €13.50 a week, I walk your dog once or several times a week in one of the Walkedo groups. Time slots are booked in advance, so you always know when your dog will be picked up. Less to worry about for you, and a happy dog waiting at home or greeting you at the door. Discover everything the walking service offers.
uitlaatservice.benefitsIntro: Walkedo is an exclusive dog walking service. We keep groups smaller than most, so your dog spends less time in the van and gets more personal attention on the walk. Here is what that means in practice.

benefits.curatedGroups: Carefully matched groups, including the walkedoodles

uitlaatservice.mapHeading: Arnhem & Oosterbeek, the nature reserves I love
uitlaatservice.mapBody: Together with the Walkedo group I have found the finest spots in Arnhem and Oosterbeek.
uitlaatservice.subscriptionBody: Walkedo works with straightforward subscriptions based on the number of walks. No occasional invoices to keep track of, and no strip cards that may or may not have expired. Monthly amounts are calculated with six weeks' allowance built in. Here is how it works: <link>subscriptions explained</link>

uitlaatservice.stepsIntro: Your dog can join sooner than you might think. Four small steps and you are a member.

signup.title: Sign up
signup.body: Get in touch through the <link>sign-up form</link>. Write a short note about your dogs so I get a sense of the type of dog and which groups would suit them.

meet.title: Introduction
meet.body: I will call or email you about your sign-up to arrange a free introduction, with no obligation. This takes place at your home. I like to get to know your dog a little, and during the conversation we can work out together when and how often they can join the group.

trial.title: Trial walk
trial.body: The first walk can be a little daunting for a dog. I take your dog out for a trial walk so we can start building a bond. There is a small one-off fee for this walk. If it feels right on both sides afterwards, you can become a member and we can draw up a key agreement.

subscription.title: Subscription
subscription.body: From this point your dog is a fixed part of the group. At the start of each month a set amount is debited, depending on the number of walks per month.

voorwaarden.title: Dog boarding terms & conditions
voorwaarden.note: This is a translation for convenience. The Dutch version of these terms is the binding one.
voorwaarden.p1: Please note: available only to dogs of Walkedo daycare, Walkedo dog walking, and Walkedo Northern Inuit Kennel clients.
voorwaarden.p2: - Please bear in mind that if the Walkedo walking service, the daycare, or the puppy application ends, you are no longer a Walkedo client and can therefore no longer use the holiday boarding.
voorwaarden.p3: - The discount for a second and third dog with the same owner is two euros per day. Each new day starts in the morning.
voorwaarden.p4: Dogs can be dropped off and/or collected before 08:30 in the morning. Dogs can be dropped off and/or collected between 17:00 and 21:00.
voorwaarden.p5: The dog joins the walking service twice (two one-hour walks) and is also walked separately once. (For puppies and older dogs we tailor this to their needs.)
voorwaarden.p6: If a dog comes into season during the stay, a surcharge of five euros per day applies.
voorwaarden.p7: Dogs that have not been neutered or spayed cannot board.
voorwaarden.p8: Dogs must be vaccinated against kennel cough one month before their stay.
voorwaarden.p9: Owners are asked to bring their own food and to explain how it should be given. Medication is no problem, but the dog must not be contagious.
voorwaarden.p10: You are also asked to leave the pet passport with us. At handover the passport is checked for all vaccinations.
voorwaarden.p11: * High season covers all school holidays and national public holidays.

casting.heroAlt: The set of a film production
casting.title: Casting
casting.subtitle: Lights, camera, Walkedo!
casting.body1: Do you need a dog with the look of a wolf for a production, film, music video, photo shoot, or marketing campaign? Walkedo can help with the Northern Inuit Dog. These dogs have a striking presence because of how closely they resemble a wolf — the breed was used in the production of Game of Thrones for exactly that reason.
casting.body2: The Northern Inuit Dog is well trained and ideal for productions with a fantasy or medieval direction. They have a gentle character and can project it, but when a scene calls for it they can also look sharp and menacing. They stand around 60cm at the shoulder and are fast and dynamic for action-driven scenes.

northernInuit.heroAlt: Northern Inuit dog in the dunes
northernInuit.title: Northern Inuit Dog
northernInuit.intro: This beautiful breed is still little known worldwide, and even less so in the Netherlands. These dogs are highly social and do well in groups and around other dogs. The breed is best known from the TV series Game of Thrones. The Northern Inuit Dog is a cross of Siberian Husky, German Shepherd, Samoyed and Alaskan Malamute. There is no wolf DNA in the Northern Inuit Dog, which is what makes them well suited to life as a family pet.
